question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

In the coming millenium, some noticeable technological advancements will be accomplished.
solution:
The correct answer is **'millenium****'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We have to select the **erroneous spelling** as our correct option.
 
• Here,** noticeable** means easy to see or notice. (जो सहज ही दिखाई पड़े या जिस पर सहज ही ध्यान जाए, स्‍पष्‍ट या ध्यानाकर्षक)
 
• **Technological **means relating to or associated with technology. (प्रौद्योगिकी-विषयक)
 
• ** Advancements** means the process of helping something to make progress and succeed. (उन्‍नति, प्रगति)
 
• We can notice that all the above options are having correct spellings and we are left with the last option '**millenium**'.
 
• The spelling of '**millenium**' is **incorrect** and the correct spelling is** 'millennium'** .It means a period of 1000 years.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

**Correct Sentence:__ ***In the coming __**millennium**__, some noticeable technological advancements will be accomplished. *
